reason_for_gap: Not every control is tri-state-capable on every platform. Some controls are 'compliant via absence' (no CLI FAIL form exists, e.g. Junos telnet/http/finger, PAN-OS unused-port zoning) so only PASS+FAIL is meaningful and MISSING is identical to PASS. Others are 'FAIL == MISSING' (no distinct non-compliant VALUE exists, only the line's presence/absence matters, e.g. AAA/password-policy/syslog/NTP/ACL/banner/OSPF-auth-style controls) so only PASS+MISSING is meaningful and FAIL is skipped as a duplicate. Two PAN-OS controls (CTRL-001 SSH version, CTRL-002 telnet) are always_compliant by platform design with no CLI toggle at all, so only PASS exists for those.
